method: The exact Leica body ran against deterministic full-range signed16-difference fields, 14-bit green fields, edge injections and random full-u16 destination canaries. Scalar outputs were overlaid only into the proven formal interior of the original random destination windows, leaving every guard/tail cell unchanged. The complete 1024-halfword A and B destination windows and mutable support word were compared after every run.

result.conclusion: ASMRedBlueInterpolation1 arithmetic, geometry, caller phase/support behavior and tested destination-side physical write behavior are closed at whole-buffer parity for the frozen matrix.

next_gate: Exact production GreenInterpolationWithCo -> ASMRedBlueInterpolation1 composite machine-versus-scalar parity using the shared descriptor planes and mutable phase/support state.
